name: cache-watch
description: Shows above the prompt, in one line, whether the conversation's prompt cache is still warm and how much of the weekly Fable limit is left; warns before a send that would re-write a cold cache, and can keep the cache warm for a capped time. The cache lifetime defaults to 60 minutes (the 1-hour cache window); set it to 5 for the Claude Code default.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime in minutes
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last API call: 60 for the 1-hour window, 5 for the Claude Code default.

maxKeepWarmHours.title: Keep-warm limit in hours
maxKeepWarmHours.description: The longest time keep-warm runs after it is started.

cacheWriteUsdPerMillion.title: Cache-write price, USD per million tokens
cacheWriteUsdPerMillion.description: Used only for the estimate shown as about $. The default 18.75 is a plain estimate; set it to the cache-write price of the model you use.
